original_card.question: Does one changed supplier or assembly claim lack a source-bound independent check of a specific new implication?
methods: Independently reconstruct a coordinated frame/circuit change and its single-change control, then derive the complete rank and physical ledger.
Implement certified moment inequalities through a different exact enclosure method.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Demonstrate independence, source binding, positive cases and semantic failure controls. Name the existing checks and the missing coverage. More digits or another equivalent evaluation of an unchanged root is not by itself new verification coverage.

first_step.inspect: Read #2979 joint rank-7 end-frame proposal and the revision-6 evidence status. Its claimed kappa is not selected. Compare coordinated changes with the losing single-change controls and locate the complete physical ledger; an aggregate moment alone does not validate the mechanism.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Prioritize a bounded independent audit of #2979: reconstruct one joint group and its single-lowering control, check the declared frames/chronology, then trace changed children, idle widths and cleanup buffers into the complete invoice and both supplier caps. Choose one still-missing implication after checking existing audits. Stop with exact unresolved dependencies if full admission exceeds the session; do not launch a new lowering census on an unvalidated premise or substitute extra root digits for mechanism checking.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Independent pricing prevents unsupported frontier claims and can reveal genuine accounting slack.
allowed_variations: Reconstruct either a source ledger or a numeric enclosure with a different method.
scope_change_triggers: Importing the primary function and calling its output independent verification.
Promoting #2979 from merged source archive to validated supplier solely from author PASS receipts or aggregate pricing.

actual_scope: Independent exact replay of the rank-changing paired-axis correction family suggested by PR3187: for each of the 112 T740 port recipes, move one common residual axis on both streams of child pair (8,10) to both streams of pair (12,13), or in reverse, subject to destination orthogonality. Check the actual hosted eight-stream operator at the moved axis character for every candidate, then derive the orthogonal-isolation argument for simultaneous candidates in this restricted class.
scope_change_reason: PR3187 gives an exact counterexample to PR3184’s first single-stream star move. This refines the independent-moment audit to the strongest immediate two-stream symmetry correction: transferring the same phase on both channels might commute where a single-channel transfer fails. The new replay is independently implemented and the scope is limited to this rank-changing paired family.
bottleneck_link: A better rank histogram changes the moment only if the exact hosted eight-stream physical operator is preserved. This screen tests whether a natural paired correction can turn PR3184’s structural idle-axis gains into an admissible profile; it does not price a new supplier.
stop_rule: Authenticate the complete T740 fill and all 112 recipes; verify a positive baseline; enumerate every paired common-axis transfer that raises destination rank without replacing a nonorthogonal destination axis; test the exact operator at its own character. Stop this family if all candidates fail. Do not generalize to matched swaps, longer cycles, other child pairs, replicas, or all operator-preserving assignments.
evidence: verify.py authenticates the PR3148 T740 payload SHA256 8f4d6965…e00, checks the baseline on 147 modes for port 0 plus the zero-character identity for all ports, and tests 2,688 forward plus 2,688 reverse candidates (24 each direction on every one of 112 port recipes) for owner replica zero. Every candidate changes the exact Gaussian-integer stream matrix at its own Fourier character. Since eligible moved axes are pairwise orthogonal, any simultaneous nonempty set in this restricted class is isolated by one moved-axis character and fails too. Exact port-0 witness: axis 7; receipt is RESULT.json. No new kappa, supplier admission, or selected-frontier change.
author: OpenAI Codex
ai_assistance: OpenAI Codex wrote the independent exact replay, source-bound census and package. No independent human review or proof-assistant verification is claimed.

open_questions.question: Can a net-rank-changing matched swap or longer axis cycle, which removes nonorthogonal destination directions while adding new ones, preserve the full operator across the intervening bridges?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The screened rank-changing family requires each incoming axis to be orthogonal to the full destination basis. Removing a matched axis relaxes that condition and is the simplest remaining way this child-pair geometry could evade the negative result.
open_questions.first_step: Build the 48-by-48 cross-Gram graph for each port, enumerate the smallest cycles that produce a nonzero child-rank imbalance, and replay each full overlay against the exact T740 schedule.
open_questions.blocked_by: No exact symbolic criterion for multi-axis cycles is supplied; cycle interactions can involve hosted phases and all intervening bridges.

open_questions.question: Does any other child/time pair on the T740 schedule admit a physically valid rank-changing transfer?
open_questions.why_it_matters: A different schedule cut could change the rank profile while avoiding this paired obstruction.
open_questions.first_step: Derive exact insertion-to-insertion intertwiners for each candidate pair and use the current port-0 witness as a regression control before optimizing a new profile.
open_questions.blocked_by: This package audits only child pairs (8,10) and (12,13) on owner replica zero; a complete all-pair search is outside its bounded scope.
